s: But the cormorant and the bittern shall possess it; the owl also and the raven shall dwell in it: and he shall stretch out upon it the line of confusion, and the stones of «emptiness».
Now it came to pass, when they had heard the law, that they «separated» from Israel all the mixed multitude.

H996.d: between, among, in the midst of (with other preps), from between
s: And Resen «between» Nineveh and Calah: the same is a great city.
Which «make» oil within their walls, and tread their winepresses, and suffer thirst.

H929.d: beast, cattle, animal; beasts (coll of all animals); cattle, livestock (of domestic animals); wild beasts
s: Whosoever lieth with a «beast» shall surely be put to death.
But all the «cattle», and the spoil of the cities, we took for a prey to ourselves.
A lion which is strongest «among» «beasts», and turneth not away for any;
And the gold of that land is good: there is «bdellium» and the onyx stone.

H905.d: alone, by itself, besides, a part, separation, being alone; separation, alone, by itself; part; parts (eg limbs, shoots), bars
s: He that sacrificeth unto any god, save unto the LORD «only», he shall be utterly destroyed.
They shall have like portions to eat, «beside» that which cometh of the sale of his patrimony.
And thou shalt make «staves» of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.
And the LORD said unto Moses, Take unto thee sweet spices, stacte, and onycha, and galbanum; these sweet spices with pure frankincense: of «each» shall there be a like weight:

H935.d: to go in, enter, come, go, come in
s: And thou shalt «go» to thy fathers in peace; thou shalt be buried in a good old age.
And the man did as Joseph bade; and the man «brought» the men into Joseph’s house.
And Saul smote the Amalekites from Havilah until thou «comest» to Shur, that is over against Egypt.
And there «went» a proclamation throughout the host about the «going» down of the sun, saying, Every man to his city, and every man to his own country.
Oh that I might have my «request»; and that God would grant me the thing that I long for!

H954.d: to put to shame, be ashamed, be disconcerted, be disappointed; (Piel) to delay (in shame); (Hithpolel) to be ashamed before one another
s: And they were both naked, the man and his wife, and were not «ashamed».
They cried unto thee, and were delivered: they trusted in thee, and were not «confounded».
The rod and reproof give wisdom: but a child left to himself bringeth his mother to «shame».

H977.d: to choose, elect, decide for; (Qal) to choose; (Niphal) to be chosen; (Pual) to be chosen, selected
s: Then Jesse made Shammah to pass by. And he said, Neither hath the LORD «chosen» this.
How much less shall I answer him, and «choose» out my words to reason with him?

H938.d: A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, only mentioned at Gen.22.21;; second son of Nahor, Abraham's nephew; a Gadite
s: Huz his firstborn, and «Buz» his brother, and Kemuel the father of Aram,
These are the children of Abihail the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of «Buz»;
Dedan, and Tema, and «Buz», and all that are in the utmost corners,

H990.d: belly, womb, body; belly, abdomen; womb
s: And when her days to be delivered were fulfilled, behold, there were twins in her «womb».
Should a wise man utter vain knowledge, and fill his «belly» with the east wind?
The words of a talebearer are as wounds, and they go down into the innermost parts of the «belly».

H959.d: to despise, hold in contempt, disdain; (Qal) to despise, regard with contempt; (Hiphil) to cause to despise
s: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and «despised» of the people.
But whoso hearkeneth unto me shall dwell «safely», and shall be quiet from fear of evil.
And I will send a fire on Magog, and among them that dwell «carelessly» in the isles: and they shall know that I am the LORD.
Devise not evil against thy neighbour, seeing he dwelleth «securely» by thee.

H962.d: to spoil, plunder, prey upon, seize; (Qal) to spoil, plunder, despoil; (Niphal) to be spoiled, plundered; (Pual) to be taken as spoil
s: Let the extortioner catch all that he hath; and let the strangers «spoil» his labour.
«Take» ye the spoil of silver, take the spoil of gold: for there is none end of the store and glory out of all the pleasant furniture.
But all the cattle, and the spoil of the cities, we «took» for a prey to ourselves.

H911.d: A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.36.35
s: And Husham died, and Hadad the son of «Bedad», who smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Avith.

H953.d: pit, well, cistern, dungeon, pit of the grave
s: He made a «pit», and digged it, and is fallen into the ditch which he made.

H937.d: contempt; springing from evil; springing from prosperity; springing from judgment
s: He poureth «contempt» upon princes, and weakeneth the strength of the mighty.

H995.d: to discern, understand, consider; (Niphal) to be discerning, intelligent, discreet, have understanding; (Hithpolel) to show oneself discerning or attentive, consider diligently; (Polel) to teach, instruct; (TWOT) prudent, regard
s: Teach me, and I will hold my tongue: and cause me to «understand» wherein I have erred.
For he knoweth vain men: he seeth wickedness also; will he not then «consider» it?
The heart of the «prudent» getteth knowledge; and the ear of the wise seeketh knowledge.

H974.d: to examine, try, prove; (Niphal) to be tried, proved; (Pual) to make a trial
s: And that thou shouldest visit him every morning, and «try» him every moment?
But he knoweth the way that I take: when he hath «tried» me, I shall come forth as gold.

H992.d: pistachio nuts-delicacy given to Joseph by Jacob through his sons
s: And their father Israel said unto them, If it must be so now, do this; take of the best fruits in the land in your vessels, and carry down the man a present, a little balm, and a little honey, spices, and myrrh, «nuts», and almonds:

H994.d: if it please, pray excuse me, excuse me please; used to introduce an entreaty or request
s: And said, O «sir», we came indeed down at the first time to buy food:

H926.d: to disturb, alarm, terrify, hurry, be disturbed, be anxious, be afraid, be hurried, be nervous
s: They saw it, and so they marvelled; they were troubled, and «hasted» away.
Even when I remember I «am» afraid, and trembling taketh hold on my flesh.

H943.d: to perplex, confuse, be confused; (Niphal) to be confused, be in confusion

s: But Samuel ministered before the LORD, being a child, girded with a «linen» ephod.

H931.d: thumb, great (big) toe (always used of both together)
s: And he slew it; and Moses took of the blood of it, and put it upon the tip of Aaron’s right ear, and upon the «thumb» of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot.

H981.d: to speak rashly or angrily, speak thoughtlessly; (Qal) one that babbles, speaks rashly (part.); (Piel) to speak rashly, unadvisedly
s: Or if a soul swear, «pronouncing» with his lips to do evil, or to do good, whatsoever it be that a man shall pronounce with an oath, and it be hid from him; when he knoweth of it, then he shall be guilty in one of these.

H934.d: white patch of skin, brightness, bright spot (on skin); (CLBL) bright spot, scar, blister, boil; resulting from fire; resulting from inflammation of the skin; possible sign of leprosy
s: And for a rising, and for a scab, and for a «bright» «spot»:

H933.d: a harmless eruption of the skin, skin spot

H910.d: isolation, withdrawal, separation; an isolated city; alone; security (fig.)
s: So the LORD «alone» did lead him, and there was no strange god with him.

H928.d: dismay, sudden terror or ruin, alarm
s: I also will do this unto you; I will even appoint over you «terror», consumption, and the burning ague, that shall consume the eyes, and cause sorrow of heart: and ye shall sow your seed in vain, for your enemies shall eat it.
Remember now thy Creator in the days of thy «youth», while the evil days come not, nor the years draw nigh, when thou shalt say, I have no pleasure in them;
Therefore will I save my flock, and they shall no more be a «prey»; and I will judge between cattle and cattle.
Thy substance and thy treasures will I give to the «spoil» without price, and that for all thy sins, even in all thy borders.
Only the gold, and the silver, the brass, the iron, the «tin», and the lead,

H998.d: understanding, discernment; act; faculty; object; personified
s: And now I have sent a cunning man, endued with «understanding», of Huram my father’s,

H982.d: to trust; (TWOT) to feel safe, be careless
s: Wilt thou «trust» him, because his strength is great? or wilt thou leave thy labour to him?
And thou shalt be «secure», because there is hope; yea, thou shalt dig about thee, and thou shalt take thy rest in safety.
Neither let Hezekiah «make» you «trust» in the LORD, saying, The LORD will surely deliver us: this city shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.
Even the youths shall faint and be weary, and the «young» «men» shall utterly fall:
The fire consumed their young «men»; and their maidens were not given to marriage.
And from Heshbon unto Ramath-mizpeh, and «Betonim»; and from Mahanaim unto the border of Debir;

H932.d: A man living before Israel's Monarchy, first mentioned at Jos.15.6; a Reubenite who set a boundary stone between Judah and Benjamin; (BDB) a mark of division between Judah and Benjamin
s: And the border went up to Beth-hogla, and passed along by the north of Beth-arabah; and the border went up to the stone of «Bohan» the son of Reuben:
And their border was Helkath, and Hali, and «Beten», and Achshaph,
And Judah went up; and the LORD delivered the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hand: and they slew of them in «Bezek» ten thousand men.
And when he numbered them in «Bezek», the children of Israel were three hundred thousand, and the men of Judah thirty thousand.

H917.d: A Judge living before Israel's Monarchy, first mentioned at Jdg.4.6;; a judge who followed Gideon; a Manassite
s: And the LORD sent Jerubbaal, and «Bedan», and Jephthah, and Samuel, and delivered you out of the hand of your enemies on every side, and ye dwelled safe.
And the sons of Ulam; «Bedan». These were the sons of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.

And between the passages, by which Jonathan sought to go over unto the Philistines’ garrison, there was a sharp rock on the one side, and a sharp rock on the other side: and the name of the one was «Bozez», and the name of the other Seneh.
And her husband went with her along weeping behind her to «Bahurim». Then said Abner unto him, Go, return. And he returned.
And from «Betah», and from Berothai, cities of Hadadezer, king David took exceeding much brass.

H972.d: chosen, choice one, chosen one, elect (of God)
s: I have made a covenant with my «chosen», I have sworn unto David my servant,
For Jacob my servant’s sake, and Israel «mine» elect, I have even called thee by thy name: I have surnamed thee, though thou hast not known me.

And in the eleventh year, in the month «Bul», which is the eighth month, was the house finished throughout all the parts thereof, and according to all the fashion of it. So was he seven years in building it.

So he offered upon the altar which he had made in Beth-el the fifteenth day of the eighth month, even in the month which he had «devised» of his own heart; and ordained a feast unto the children of Israel: and he offered upon the altar, and burnt incense.

H920.d: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 2Ki.9.25
s: Then said Jehu to «Bidkar» his captain, Take up, and cast him in the portion of the field of Naboth the Jezreelite: for remember how that, when I and thou rode together after Ahab his father, the LORD laid this burden upon him;

H919.d: fissure, rent, breach, leak (in a building)
s: Thy riches, and thy fairs, thy merchandise, thy mariners, and thy pilots, thy «calkers», and the occupiers of thy merchandise, and all thy men of war, that are in thee, and in all thy company which is in the midst of thee, shall fall into the midst of the seas in the day of thy ruin.
For to him that is joined to all the living there is «hope»: for a living dog is better than a dead lion.

H946.d: A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.2.25
s: And the sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron were, Ram the firstborn, and «Bunah», and Oren, and Ozem, and Ahijah.

H948.d: byssus, a costly, fine white linen cloth made in Egypt
s: And he made the vail of blue, and purple, and crimson, and «fine» «linen», and wrought cherubims thereon.
And they smote all the cities round about Gerar; for the fear of the LORD came upon them: and they spoiled all the cities; for there was «exceeding» much spoil in them.

H902.d: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.2.14
s: The children of «Bigvai», two thousand fifty and six.
Which came with Zerubbabel: Jeshua, Nehemiah, Seraiah, Reelaiah, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispar, «Bigvai», Rehum, Baanah. The number of the men of the people of Israel:

H989.d: (P'al) to cease; to cease; to make to cease
s: Give ye now commandment to cause these men to «cease», and that this city be not builded, until another commandment shall be given from me.

Now when the copy of king Artaxerxes’ letter was read before Rehum, and Shimshai the scribe, and their companions, they went up in «haste» to Jerusalem unto the Jews, and made them to cease by force and power.

H912.d: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Ezr.10.35

H942.d: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Neh.3.18
s: After him repaired their brethren, «Bavai» the son of Henadad, the ruler of the half part of Keilah.
Hear, O our God; for we are «despised»: and turn their reproach upon their own head, and give them for a prey in the land of captivity:

H923.d: a costly stone (perhaps porphyry), red marble
s: Where were white, green, and blue, hangings, fastened with cords of fine linen and purple to silver rings and pillars of marble: the beds were of gold and silver, upon a pavement of «red», and blue, and white, and black, marble.

H968.d: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Est.1.10
s: On the seventh day, when the heart of the king was merry with wine, he commanded Mehuman, «Biztha», Harbona, Bigtha, and Abagtha, Zethar, and Carcas, the seven chamberlains that served in the presence of Ahasuerus the king,

H903.d: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Est.1.10
s: On the seventh day, when the heart of the king was merry with wine, he commanded Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, «Bigtha», and Abagtha, Zethar, and Carcas, the seven chamberlains that served in the presence of Ahasuerus the king,
Likewise shall the ladies of Persia and Media say this day unto all the king’s princes, which have heard of the deed of the queen. Thus shall there arise too much «contempt» and wrath.

H904.d: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Est.2.21; also called Bigthana at Est.6.2
s: In those days, while Mordecai sat in the king’s gate, two of the king’s chamberlains, «Bigthan» and Teresh, of those which kept the door, were wroth, and sought to lay hand on the king Ahasuerus.

H907.d: empty talk, idle talk, liar, lie
s: That frustrateth the «tokens» of the liars, and maketh diviners mad; that turneth wise men backward, and maketh their knowledge foolish;
The tabernacles of robbers prosper, and they that provoke God are «secure»; into whose hand God bringeth abundantly.

H940.d: Someone descended from Ram (H7410I), first mentioned at Job.32.2
s: And Elihu the son of Barachel the «Buzite» answered and said, I am young, and ye are very old; wherefore I was afraid, and durst not shew you mine opinion.

H930.d: Behemoth; a Diplodocus or Brachiosaurus, exact meaning unknown 1b) hippopotamus; a mythical or proverbial creature
s: Behold now «behemoth», which I made with thee; he eateth grass as an ox.
Surely the mountains bring him forth food, where all the «beasts» of the field play.

H947.d: to tread down, reject, trample down; (Hophal) to be trodden down
s: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall «tread» «down» our enemies.
Many pastors have destroyed my vineyard, they have «trodden» my portion under foot, they have made my pleasant portion a desolate wilderness.

H967.d: to scatter, disperse; (Qal) to scatter; (Piel) to scatter
s: Rebuke the company of spearmen, the multitude of the bulls, with the calves of the people, till every one submit himself with pieces of silver: «scatter» thou the people that delight in war.
The days of his youth hast thou shortened: thou hast covered him with «shame». Selah.

H909.d: to withdraw, be separate, be isolated; (Qal) an army straggler (part.); (TWOT) alone

H936.d: to despise, hold in contempt, hold as insignificant; (Qal) to despise, show despite toward
s: Men do not «despise» a thief, if he steal to satisfy his soul when he is hungry;

H952.d: to make clear, clear up, explain, prove; (CLBL) to bore into; (TWOT) to declare (?)
s: For all this I considered in my heart even to «declare» all this, that the righteous, and the wise, and their works, are in the hand of God: no man knoweth either love or hatred by all that is before them.
In the day when the keepers of the house shall tremble, and the strong men shall bow themselves, and the grinders «cease» because they are few, and those that look out of the windows be darkened,

That sendeth ambassadors by the sea, even in vessels of bulrushes upon the waters, saying, Go, ye swift messengers, to a nation scattered and peeled, to a people terrible from their beginning hitherto; a nation meted out and trodden down, whose land the rivers have «spoiled»!

Behold the land of the Chaldeans; this people was not, till the Assyrian founded it for them that dwell in the wilderness: they set up the «towers» thereof, they raised up the palaces thereof; and he brought it to ruin.
Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD, Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a «tried» stone, a precious corner stone, a sure foundation: he that believeth shall not make haste.
And yet for all this her «treacherous» sister Judah hath not turned unto me with her whole heart, but feignedly, saith the LORD.

H969.d: assayer (an inspector and valuer of metals)
s: I have «set» thee for a tower and a fortress among my people, that thou mayest know and try their way.

H941.d: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Ezk.1.3
s: The word of the LORD came expressly unto Ezekiel the priest, the son of «Buzi», in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and the hand of the LORD was there upon him.
And the living creatures ran and returned as the appearance of a flash of «lightning».

H927.d: (Pual) to frighten, alarm, dismay; (Ithpa'al) to hurry, hasten; (Ithpa'al) alarmed (part.)
s: Then the king arose very early in the morning, and went in «haste» unto the den of lions.
He cried aloud, and said thus, Hew down the tree, and cut off his branches, shake off his leaves, and «scatter» his fruit: let the beasts get away from under it, and the fowls from his branches:
Then the king went to his palace, and «passed» the «night» fasting: neither were instruments of musick brought before him: and his sleep went from him.

And behold another beast, a second, like to a bear, and it raised up itself on one side, and it had three ribs in the mouth of it «between» the teeth of it: and they said thus unto it, Arise, devour much flesh.

H915.d: a piece, severed piece, a piece (of an ear)
s: Thus saith the LORD; As the shepherd taketh out of the mouth of the lion two legs, or a «piece» of an ear; so shall the children of Israel be taken out that dwell in Samaria in the corner of a bed, and in Damascus in a couch.

H900.d: treacherous, treacherousness, men of treacherous behaviour
s: Her prophets are light and «treacherous» persons: her priests have polluted the sanctuary, they have done violence to the law.
Three shepherds also I cut off in one month; and my soul lothed them, and their soul also «abhorred» me.
